scope: Real staging browser; silent synthetic mic; one trial each except Qwen cold/warm; decoded audio, not physical speaker latency; 1.4x pace

Listen for a clear, brisk delivery without fuzz or missing words. You can interrupt me, or ask for your real thread briefing when you are ready.
